name: The Blacksmith
description: A proud master of his trade who bargains for greatness, then relies on boldness and clever wishes to escape the Devil’s claim.
visualPrompt: Broad-shouldered blacksmith with soot-smudged face and strong hands, leather apron over simple work clothes, carrying a heavy sledgehammer; confident, stubborn expression; old forge tools and faint embers nearby

name: The Devil
description: A contract-bound tempter repeatedly humiliated by the blacksmith’s traps: the pear tree, the armchair, and the steel-wire purse.
visualPrompt: Sinister yet worldly devilish figure with sharp features and predatory grin, dressed like a sly traveler; suggests supernatural menace without exaggeration; uneasy posture as if wary of tricks

name: Our Lord
description: A calm wanderer who demonstrates miraculous skill in the forge, rebukes cruelty, and grants the blacksmith three ill-chosen but potent wishes.
visualPrompt: Serene traveler with gentle authority, plain robe and sandals, warm steady gaze; hands poised as if shaping hot iron with effortless mastery; subtle aura of goodness without spectacle

name: Saint Peter
description: The Lord’s companion who warns that the blacksmith should have wished for grace instead of tricks, and who guards Heaven’s gate at the end.
visualPrompt: Older man with weathered face and thoughtful eyes, simple cloak, holding a large key ring at a bright gate; cautious, measured stance

name: The Journeyman Tailor
description: A thin traveler bound for Heaven, whose timely entrance contrasts the blacksmith’s late, forceful attempt to follow.
visualPrompt: Lean journeyman tailor in worn but tidy clothes, carrying a pressing iron in one hand; quick, nervous steps; hopeful expression aimed toward a distant bright gate
